name: Wanko no Yomeiri ~Arata na Nihon no Shippo~
original_name: わんこの嫁入り～新たな二本のしっぽ～
source:
Days after Touya married the dog-eared divine messengers Koharu and Azuki, the shrine cafe “Inu no Shippo” had become quite popular and they enjoyed their time together passionately. However, two new divine messengers Fubuki and Kaede came to monitor them one day. What will become of their private lives?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/08/01/august-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
灯矢与卷角的神圣使者小春和小豆结婚几天后，神社咖啡馆“犬之七宝”变得相当受欢迎，他们热情地享受着在一起的时光。然而，有一天，两名新的神圣使者吹雪和枫前来监视他们。他们的私生活将会怎样？

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/08/01/august-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
